source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check if MB_ME LED works normally
1. Power on server and check MB_ME LED

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

original_test_intent: Visually confirm that the motherboard ME indicator assigned by the exact platform design exhibits its specified operating pattern while the server is powered on.
original_method: Power on the server, locate the MB_ME LED using the platform drawing, and have an engineer observe and photograph its color, blink pattern and timing for comparison with the product specification.
manual_activity: A qualified engineer must identify the correct MB_ME indicator and visually assess its emitted light and timing, potentially inside the chassis. Telemetry cannot substitute for this optical acceptance.
required_inputs: Exact board/chassis revision and labeled MB_ME LED drawing
Authoritative expected color, steady/blink cadence, tolerance and observation interval
Required power, POST and management-engine state
Safe chassis access/ESD procedure and maintenance window
Photo/video method and one-user approval if a power transition is needed
safety_requirements: Do not assume the indicator is a BMC heartbeat LED or that GREEN is correct without the platform specification.
Do not open or reach into a live chassis outside the approved service/ESD procedure.
Do not reset ME/BMC, alter firmware or cycle power merely to force the expected pattern.
Preserve existing logs and stop on ambiguous indicator identity or unsafe access.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only power, POST, BMC/ME health and event timestamps to correlate the operator's visual record.
Validate photo/video metadata and organize the observed cadence against the supplied specification.
Flag mismatches while leaving visual confirmation and verdict to the engineer.
engineer_actions: Supply/confirm the board drawing and expected MB_ME LED pattern.
Safely observe and record the physical indicator in the defined server state.
Compare the evidence to the specification and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its no-command/manual boundary is correct, but the asserted BMC-heartbeat identity and green pattern are unsupported and must be discarded.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use only read-only platform power/ME health queries as correlation; no software command proves physical LED color or cadence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The powered-on MB_ME observation and 5/10-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a board-revision overlay to identify the LED and capture a timestamped video long enough to measure the specified cadence, with synchronized read-only power and ME-health evidence.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact board/chassis revision and its ME implementation.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board, BIOS/ME and BMC firmware plus LED spec revision.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner platform board drawing, ME LED table and chassis safety procedure.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds unambiguous target mapping and measurable timing evidence without automating the observation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No loss; visual state remains authoritative.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: LED identity, pattern/tolerance and safe observation state.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Camera exposure and frame rate can distort color or cadence and require engineer confirmation.

project_override_considerations: The project supplies the applicable board/spec and observation duration. Missing spec makes the test NOT READY rather than permanently BLOCKED; it does not justify using an assumed generic BMC heartbeat pattern.
expected_evidence: Board revision, MB_ME LED map, expected color/cadence/tolerance and test-state definition
Timestamped photo/video showing DUT identity and the precise indicator
Correlated power/POST/ME/BMC state and preserved SEL/UEFI evidence
Engineer observation record and separate formal verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently requests an MB_ME LED check against an external specification. The unsupported BMC/GREEN detail exists only in the DeepSeek review, not the source.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The operation is a clear manual visual inspection. Board-specific identity and expected pattern are obtainable readiness inputs under V3.1.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keep the manual-only boundary but remove its invented BMC heartbeat and green assumptions.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retain target/spec safety concerns while changing permanent BLOCKED to NOT READY.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Specifies the human optical evidence and avoids conflating ME with BMC.

review_improvement: Separates source fact (MB_ME) from an unsupported historical interpretation and makes board mapping and cadence evidence explicit.
independent_technical_reasoning: The emitted indicator state is physically observable and no remote health command can demonstrate its color or blink cadence. Missing board documentation affects readiness, not the manual-only classification or fundamental intelligibility of the case.
